# Riverside

> > Riverside is an all-in-one platform for recording, editing, and hosting podcasts and video content with studio-quality remote recording capabilities.

Riverside provides creators with professional tools including Magic Clips, Magic Audio, Smart Scenes, and seamless publishing to platforms like YouTube, Spotify, and Apple Podcasts. The platform serves podcasters, video producers, and enterprises with remote recording technology, AI-powered editing tools, and comprehensive hosting solutions.

## Key Topics

- Remote Recording
- Podcast Hosting
- Video Editing
- Audio Editing
- Magic Clips
- Magic Audio
- Smart Scenes
- Studio Quality
- Content Creation
- YouTube Publishing
- Apple Podcasts
- MP4 to MP3 Conversion
- H.264 Encoding
- Adobe Audition Integration
- Multi-Platform Publishing

## Core Platform Features

- [Podcast Hosting | Create and Publish With Riverside](https://riverside.com/podcast-hosting): All-in-one podcast hosting platform with publishing to Spotify & Apple
- [Audio Extractor From Video - 100% Free, With no Sign-up](https://riverside.com/tools/audio-extractor): Free audio extraction tool converting MP4 to MP3/WAV with Riverside
- [Community Hub](https://riverside.com/community): Creator community hub with resources for podcasters and video producers

## Video Editing Glossary

- [Non-Linear Editing NLE: What It Is & Practical Tips | Riverside](https://riverside.com/video-editor/video-editing-glossary/non-linear-editing-nle): Video editing glossary: NLE systems and editing workflow explanation
- [Encoding: What It Is & Practical Tips | Riverside](https://riverside.com/video-editor/video-editing-glossary/encoding): Video editing glossary: encoding, codecs, compression and H.264/HEVC
- [Video Encoder: What It Is & Practical Tips | Riverside](https://riverside.com/video-editor/video-editing-glossary/video-encoder): Video editing glossary: encoder definition covering H.264 and HEVC
- [Sequence: What It Is & Practical Tips | Riverside](https://riverside.com/video-editor/video-editing-glossary/sequence): Video editing glossary: sequence definition and timeline organization tips
- [Scopes: What It Is & Practical Tips | Riverside](https://riverside.com/video-editor/video-editing-glossary/scopes): Video editing glossary: scopes, waveform, vectorscope for color grading
- [Layouts: What It Is & Practical Tips | Riverside](https://riverside.com/video-editor/video-editing-glossary/layouts): Video editing glossary: layouts, Smart Scenes, and multi-layout clips
- [Import: What It Is & Practical Tips | Riverside](https://riverside.com/video-editor/video-editing-glossary/import): Video editing glossary: importing media files and workflow basics
- [FLV: What It Is & Practical Tips | Riverside](https://riverside.com/video-editor/video-editing-glossary/flv): Video editing glossary: Flash Video (FLV) format and legacy streaming
